epics.title: System Action Audit Log
epics.jtbd: When users interact with the system, I want their actions to be logged in a dedicated journal, so that administrators can audit metadata changes and permission updates.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: percentage of user modification actions successfully recorded in the audit log
requirements: R1: When an authenticated user modifies document metadata or access rights, a record must be created in a central audit journal capturing the user identity, timestamp, and details of the change.

slices.title: Patch audit logging into metadata and access right modification flows
slices.jtbd: When implementing the central audit journal patch for this epic, I want to insert logging calls into existing metadata and access modification methods, so that the central user action audit journal is populated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated user,
When the user modifies document metadata or access rights,
Then a record must be created in the central audit journal capturing the user identity, timestamp, and details of the change, and tested verifying the audit log persistence.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: percentage of patched modification methods successfully logging actions

epics.title: Anti-Virus Scan on File Uploads
epics.jtbd: When a user uploads a file, I want the file to be scanned for malware, so that the knowledge base does not distribute infected documents.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: percentage of uploaded files successfully scanned for malware before saving
requirements: R1: When a user uploads a new document or version, the file must be passed through an anti-virus scanner before being saved to the upload directory.

slices.title: Patch anti-virus scan into file upload service
slices.jtbd: When implementing the anti-virus scan patch for this epic, I want to insert scanning logic into the existing file upload flow, so that malware scanning occurs before saving.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user uploading a new document or version,
When the file is transferred to the server,
Then it must be passed through an anti-virus scanner before being saved to the upload directory, and tested verifying infected files are rejected.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: percentage of file uploads passing through malware scanning
